mapper.sql: id, delivery_no, contract_id, inquiry_id, batch_no, buyer_tenant_id, supplier_tenant_id, quantity, amount, currency, delivery_terms, delivery_place, delivery_date, status, ship_company, ship_tracking_no, ship_qty, ship_date, ship_attachment_key, ship_time, receive_time, receive_qty, receive_diff_remark, receive_attachment_key, accept_result, accept_time, accept_remark, defective_qty, reship_from, return_reason, confirmed_delivery_date, penalty_days, penalty_amount, penalty_calculated_at, return_attachment_key, return_ship_company, return_ship_tracking_no, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
id, delivery_id, action, action_desc, operator_tenant_id, operator_user_id, remark, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery ( delivery_no, contract_id, inquiry_id, batch_no, buyer_tenant_id, supplier_tenant_id, quantity, amount, currency, delivery_terms, delivery_place, delivery_date, status, ship_company, ship_tracking_no, ship_qty, ship_date, ship_attachment_key, ship_time, create_by, reship_from ) VALUES ( #{deliveryNo}, #{contractId}, #{inquiryId}, #{batchNo}, #{buyerTenantId}, #{supplierTenantId}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{deliveryTerms}, #{deliveryPlace}, #{deliveryDate}, #{status}, #{shipCompany}, #{shipTrackingNo}, #{shipQty}, #{shipDate}, #{shipAttachmentKey}, #{shipTime}, #{createBy}, #{reshipFrom} )
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery SET status = 'shipped', ship_company = #{shipCompany}, ship_tracking_no = #{shipTrackingNo}, ship_qty = #{shipQty}, ship_date = #{shipDate}, ship_attachment_key = #{shipAttachmentKey}, ship_time = NOW(), receive_time = NULL, receive_qty = NULL, receive_diff_remark = NULL, receive_attachment_key = NULL, accept_result = NULL, accept_remark = NULL, return_reason = NULL, return_attachment_key = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND supplier_tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('pending_shipment', 'returned', 'reship_pending') AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE delivery SET status = 'received', receive_time = NOW(), receive_qty = #{receiveQty}, receive_diff_remark = #{receiveDiffRemark}, receive_attachment_key = #{receiveAttachmentKey}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'shipped' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE delivery SET status = 'return_pending', accept_result = 'returned', accept_time = NOW(), return_reason = #{returnReason}, return_attachment_key = #{returnAttachmentKey}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'received' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE delivery SET status = 'accepted', accept_result = 'partial', accept_time = NOW(), defective_qty = #{defectiveQty}, return_reason = #{returnReason}, return_attachment_key = #{returnAttachmentKey}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'received' AND reship_from IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE delivery SET status = 'received', accept_result = NULL, return_reason = NULL, return_attachment_key = NULL, return_ship_company = NULL, return_ship_tracking_no = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND supplier_tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'return_pending' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE delivery SET status = 'return_shipping', return_ship_company = #{returnShipCompany}, return_ship_tracking_no = #{returnShipTrackingNo}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'return_confirmed' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status != 'accepted' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status = 'accepted' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT batch_no FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(batch_no), 0) FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND reship_from IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND reship_from IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM delivery WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status = 'pending_shipment' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY quantity DESC, batch_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_trace (delivery_id, action, action_desc, operator_tenant_id, operator_user_id, remark) VALUES (#{deliveryId}, #{action}, #{actionDesc}, #{operatorTenantId}, #{operatorUserId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery_trace WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sample_size, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN accept_result IN ('accepted','partial') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pass_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN accept_result = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS return_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ship_date <= COALESCE(confirmed_delivery_date, delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS on_time_count FROM delivery WHERE supplier_tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND reship_from IS NULL AND accept_result IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT FROM delivery d WHERE d.status IN ('pending_shipment','shipped','received','reship_pending') AND COALESCE(d.confirmed_delivery_date, d.delivery_date) <= #{deadline} AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM delivery_trace t WHERE t.delivery_id = d.id AND t.action = 'delay_warning' )
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery SET penalty_days = #{penaltyDays}, penalty_amount = #{penaltyAmount}, penalty_calculated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
